para.dtcname: CAN Bus Line Short to Each Other Inspection

content5.ptxt: If the resistance between 6 (CANH) and 14 (CANL) of DLC3 is less than 54 Ω, a short circuit between the CAN bus lines is suspected.

entry.ptxt: Resistance between 6 (CANH) and 14 (CANL) of DLC3 is less than 54 Ω

item.ptxt: Instrument Panel Junction Block Assembly (Main Body ECU)

atten3.ptxt: When measuring the resistance of the CAN bus, turn the IG OFF, confirm that warning functions such as the key reminder warning system are not operating, and leave the vehicle for 1 minutes or more without operating the key or switches or opening/closing the doors before starting measurement. If it is necessary to open a door during inspection, open it beforehand.

atten4.ptxt: When disconnecting a connector, check that the connector terminals and connector case are free of damage, deformation, corrosion, etc.

testgrp.testtitle: CAN Bus Line Short Circuit Inspection (DLC3 Branch Line)

test1.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF and disconnect the CAN J/C2 connector.
Using the SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the terminals of DLC3.
